title: Free UI Cards series: header-art white card and full-bleed red/blue card (variant 3)
attribution_visible_in_image: No credit visible in this image; the card style, names and layout match the 'Free UI Cards' series by '@Spline' shown in vixen-ui-015 and vixen-ui-027. Not confirmed.
contains_third_party_content: Photos of people; Adobe and Behance logos in the chips.

observed.layout: Two cards on light grey. Left: white card with an abstract colorful header, avatar, indigo 'Adobe Co.' chip with logo, name 'Alex Turner', role 'Creative Director', bookmark button, stat strip (star 5.0 Rating, flag $150 hours, clock 24 Month), black 'Get In Touch' bar. Right: full-bleed red/blue card with a blurred silhouette, avatar, glass 'Behance' chip, 'Maya Johnson', 'User Experience Specialist', stats (5.0, $410 hours, 125 Month), light 'Get In Touch' bar.
observed.materials: Left: solid white. Right: gradient photo with glass chips; the silhouette is blurred.

interpretation.aesthetic: Free UI-kit card; third variant of a series.
implementation_notes: Chip is filled indigo on the light card and glass on the gradient card.
The CTA fill changes from black to a pale gradient.
interpretation.caveat: The right card's '$410 hours' and '125 Month' values are implausible or ambiguous as written (about 10 years of experience; $410/hour). They may be placeholder data.

concept_work.essence: Same structure as the series with content variations, showing the pattern survives different chips and stat values.
what_makes_it_work: Chips make affiliation visible without extra rows.
Right-card name and role are legible over the gradient.
gaps_to_make_it_work: Role text on the white card measures about 2.1:1.
Stat labels on the red card measure about 3.3-3.4:1.

links: Chip, role and stats together present credentials ahead of the CTA.

pattern.name: One card structure, two skins (header art vs full-bleed)
use_when: Talent or people marketplaces with a single contact CTA
avoid_when: Backgrounds are unpredictable and no scrim is possible
adaptation_examples: Agency team card: chip shows the department.
Mentor directory: stats become sessions, rating, rate.
failure_modes: Light grey role text on white

lessons: Test the layout with realistic data, not extreme placeholder values.
Make light grey role text pass contrast on white.

measured.palette_method: Median-cut quantization of the supplied image plus saturated-pixel hue medians. Approximate (JPEG). Items marked 'approx' were judged by eye.
measured.color_roles: Neutral page; saturated red/blue in the right card; indigo chip as the only accent on the white card.
measured.contrast_method: Estimated from compressed images. Background = dominant color in a box around the text. ratio_low = conservative estimate (mean of the most distant ~4% of pixels). ratio = best estimate (mean of the most distant ~1.5% of pixels; for text on a saturated background that appears near-white or near-black, the text is assumed pure white or black, because anti-aliasing of small text otherwise understates the contrast). Accessibility scores use ratio_low; critical failure CF1 uses ratio. Gradient or photo backgrounds are measured one text line at a time. Values within 0.4 of a threshold are borderline and should be verified in the source file.

evidence: A hire/contact card with credentials and a clear CTA.
Clean layout; the gradient skin keeps names legible.
Card conventions are followed; the stat label ambiguity persists.
One CTA is clear; no hover, disabled or loading states.
Both cards share structure, radii and icon treatment.
Another skin of a familiar card.
Scored on conservative values: primary text min 5.31:1; secondary text min 2.09:1; icon min n/a:1; non-color state cue: True.
accessibility.basis: computed from measured contrast + cue flag (scope: contrast and non-color cues only; touch targets, motion and screen-reader support cannot be assessed from a static image)

evaluation.readiness_key: A = ship with minor adjustments (>=80, no critical failure); B = needs specific fixes (60-79); C = rethink (<60)
evaluation.scope: Scored as presented in a static image. States, motion and behavior that are not shown are not scored as present.
